notes.title: 🚨 Major Update Incoming – Self-Hosted Servers + Modding 🚨
notes.content:
🖥️ Self-Hosted Servers Are Here!
We’re giving the server power to YOU.

Why the change?
We’re a small indie team (not a AAA studio with millions in hardware), and dedicated servers are insanely expensive to rent and maintain. Instead of limiting the game or charging crazy fees, we’re putting the control in your hands.

With self-hosted servers, you’ll be able to:

Run your own server worlds at home or on a host of your choice.

Push updates from your world directly to our official Discord.

(Coming Soon) Connect your own Discord channel to your server for community updates.
[hr][/hr]🛠️ Modding Support Arrives
Yes, you read that right — modding is officially coming!
Self-hosting opens the door for full mod support, letting you create, customize, and completely change the game to fit your vision. From small tweaks to total overhauls, it’s all possible.
[hr][/hr]⏳ Why Now?
We know some of you might be thinking: "This took a while..." — and you’re right. Between some major technical roadblocks and summer family time, progress slowed down. But we’re back in full force and pushing hard to get this game ready for you to play, host, and mod.
[hr][/hr]What’s Next?
Public test build for self-hosted servers.

Modding documentation & workshop support.

More community tools for server owners.
[hr][/hr]
Get ready — this is just the beginning.
We can’t wait to see the worlds you host and the mods you create.

Stay tuned,
The Watchers

notes.title: The Survival Overhaul – Craft, Build, Survive
notes.content:
⚙️ A New Era of Survival Begins! 🧟‍♂️

Survivors, the world of D.A.W.N: Darkness Awaits Withstand the Night has been reimagined with a complete gameplay overhaul. From crafting and building to survival mechanics and combat upgrades, every system has been refined to give you the tools to outlast the night.

🛠️ Crafting & Building Revamp

 Dynamic Crafting: Gather resources, craft weapons, tools, and essential survival gear.
 Modular Building: Construct your base with interactive structures, locks, and repair systems.
 Upgrades & Repairs: Fortify your defenses to withstand evolving zombie threats.
 


🔫 Combat System Reworked

 New Weapon Types: Wield powerful melee tools, ranged weapons, and throwable explosives.
 Upgradable Weapons: Improve your weapons' durability, damage, and utility as you progress.
 Traps & Mines: Strategically set traps and explosives to deal with massive hordes.


🌾 Survival Mechanics Enhanced

 Survival Stats: Manage your health, hunger, thirst, oxygen, and more. Every decision matters.
 Farming & Resource Gathering: Grow crops, chop trees, mine ore, and collect materials to survive and craft.
 Animal Breeding: Raise livestock for resources – but beware of zombie threats to your food supply.
 


🧟 Improved AI & Zombie Threat

 Zombies are smarter and react to traps, structures, and your survival tactics.
 Hordes are deadlier at night, forcing you to rely on crafted tools and prepared defenses.


What’s Next?
This is just the beginning of a larger journey. As survival evolves, so will your strategies. Build smarter, fight harder, and carve your path through the darkness.

Update Release Date: April 1, 2025

Survivors, the tools for your survival are now in your hands. Can you withstand the night?
